name: app-lavender-meeting-assistant-phone-in-hands-ghost-lettering
title: Lavender Meeting Assistant in Hands
whatItIs: A cover with hands holding a phone showing a meeting assistant home (AI greeting, upcoming meetings, task counts) on a white and lavender gradient with faint 'Meetniva' lettering and a logo tile.
whatItMeans: Soft lavender and rounded cards make a work tool feel calm rather than corporate.
techniques: Black card for today's meetings as a strong contrast
Lavender gradient cards for upcoming items
Ghost brand name behind the phone
Hands entering from left and right

vocabulary.definition: A dark card among light ones to mark the primary item.
An assistant prompt card at the top of a home screen.
Oversized faint brand text behind a subject.
